rows.evidence_section: L1T ATBD Algorithm Description, ASTER Level 1B Algorithm
rows.evidence_quote: The ASTER Level 1B (AST_L1B) algorithm applies the radiometric calibration coefficients that are calculated and appended, but not applied to the distributed AST_L1A data product.

supporting_quotes.quote: The Level-1A data product consists of the image data, the radiometric coefficients, the geometric correction coefficients and the auxiliary data. The Level-1B data products will be generated by using these data for the requested map projection and the resampling method.
This scene cutting is necessary for granularizing the Level-1A and the Level-1B data products.

rows.keyword_priority_note: 'applies the ... coefficients ... to the distributed AST_L1A data product' (priority 2).
rows.decision_procedure: Step 1b Q2 yes: AST_L1B is AST_L1A's counts with the appended radiometric/geometric coefficients applied -> derived_from (PARENT). PARENT vs INPUT: reprocessing AST_L1A changes every AST_L1B radiance, so PARENT, not INPUT.
rows.mapping_note: Same evidence as the AST_L1A -> AST_L1B CHILD row (reciprocal).
rows.confidence_rule: HIGH rule: source, statement and CMR validation all strong

rows.evidence_quote: corrected for atmospheric effects and viewing geometry for both the Visible and Near Infrared (VNIR) and Shortwave Infrared (SWIR) sensors.
rows.decision_procedure: Step 1b Q1 (inferred): AST_07 is the non-crosstalk twin of AST_07XT and shares the L2 ATBD with AST_09, both made from AST_L1B.
rows.mapping_note: No document names AST_L1B as AST_07's input; the quote only describes the product. CHILD found by naming/pattern -> LOW.
rows.confidence_rule: LOW rule: no document evidence (naming convention / CMR pattern only)
